headline: Bloomberg: Saudi Arabia loading more oil in the Gulf, striving to restore Red Sea exports | Industry News
summary: Saudi Arabia redirected oil flows to the Strait of Hormuz after shutting its east-west pipeline. It loaded millions of barrels at Gulf terminals while working to resume pipeline flows by the 26th.
why: Saudi Aramco is the kingdom's state oil company, and its export routes determine how much crude reaches global markets.
why_moved: The shutdown of the east-west pipeline forced crude exports through the Gulf, and efforts to restore Red Sea flows affect near-term supply.
